I answered Tobias in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026 and said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to it. Tobias is a member of #central-team, and ticket numbers are operational facts, so no approval was needed to share it.

My reply also passed on the open problem from that message: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports, so duplicates don't get created. I didn't find anything on whether that mismatch has since been fixed or the ticket closed.
